instruction: Mark "Witnessing a total solar eclipse" in my Bucket List Simple Note as done.
notes: Single-app task (simple_note). Username (supervisor email) is obtained via supervisor.show_profile (profile-known) and the password via supervisor.show_account_passwords (passwords-known); login yields the token. search_notes with query 'bucket list' discovers the note id (known-id), show_note reveals its current content (known-content), and update_note writes the derived content object which is the original content with the eclipse checkbox toggled from '[ ] ' to '[x] ' (static marks-done fact links original content, activity, and updated content). Only the note's content field changes; goal demands activity-done for the eclipse item in the Bucket List note. supervisor-complete-task takes the activity/note as non-API record parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; the actual API call passes no answer.
